items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: then I went with Alvino Rey after George Handy had been there.

ctx.x: So, I was with that first Buddy Rich band, it wasn’t a thrilling musical experience, except watching Buddy play, I mean it was just phenomenal in itself; and after that I went with Georgie Auld. I played with Georgie Auld in a number of bands in the spring of ‘46, summer of ‘46, then I went with Alvino Rey after George Handy had been there.
Now before we get off Buddy, I want to talk about that arrangement you did for him on, “The Song is You,” which…
